answer_2.quote: We report both the results on the entire HumanEval dataset for comparability with other work ... We also report the object-level accuracy ... We also use CLIP as an automatic metric ...

answer_4.quote: We use human evaluation by asking human annotators to determine whether the drawing matches the object (detailed in §E). We instruct the annotators to consider orientation as part of correctness ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judge whether the generated drawing matches the target object and whether the orientation is correct according to a canonical orientation.
